arxiv-2106-09341.title: Positivity for the clamped plate equation under high tension
arxiv-2106-09341.creator: Sascha Eichmann,
arxiv-2106-09341.description: Abstract 8.8.2026 Abstract: In this article we consider positivity issues for the clamped plate equation with high tension \gamma>0 . This equation is given by \Delta^{2}u-\gamma\Delta u=f under clamped boundary conditions. Here we show, that given a positive f , i.e. upwards pushing, we find a \gamma_{0}>0 such that for all \gamma\geq\gamma_{0} the bending u is indeed positive.

arxiv-2208-05634.title: Study of accretion flows around an ultraluminous X-ray source M82 X-1 using NuSTAR data
arxiv-2208-05634.creator: Santanu Mondal 1,*, Biswaraj Palit 1 and Sandip K. Chakrabarti 2
arxiv-2208-05634.description: Abstract We study the spectral properties and accretion flow behavior of an ultraluminous X-ray source M82 X-1 using NuSTAR observations. We use the physical two component advective flow (TCAF) model to fit the data and to derive the accretion flow properties of the source.

arxiv-2306-01413.title: Theory of magnetic field-stabilized compact skyrmions in thin film ferromagnets
arxiv-2306-01413.creator: Anne Bernand-Mantel, Anaïs Fondet, Sarah Barnova, Theresa M. Simon, Cyrill B. Muratov
arxiv-2306-01413.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Anne Bernand-Mantel, Anaïs Fondet, Sarah Barnova, Theresa M. Simon, Cyrill B. Muratov. We present a micromagnetic theory of compact magnetic skyrmions under applied magnetic field that accounts for the full dipolar energy and the interfacial Dzyaloshinskii-Moryia interaction (DMI) in the thin film regime. Asymptotic analysis is used to derive analytical formulas for the parametric dependence of the skyrmion size and rotation angle, as well as the energy barriers for collapse and bursting, two processes that lead to a finite skyrmion lifetime.

arxiv-2308-00580.title: On plane oscillations of the cold plasma in a constant magnetic field
arxiv-2308-00580.creator: Olga S. Rozanova
arxiv-2308-00580.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Olga S. Rozanova. We consider a class of two-dimensional solutions of the cold plasma equations compatible with a constant magnetic field and a constant electric field. For this class, under various assumptions about the electric field, we study the conditions on the initial data that guarantee the global existence of the classical solution of the Cauchy problem for a given period of time or a finite blowup. Particular attention is paid to the class of solutions with axial symmetry.

arxiv-2405-02175.description: Abstract Hoaxes are a recognised form of disinformation created deliberately, with potential serious implications in the credibility of reference knowledge resources such as Wikipedia. What makes detecting Wikipedia hoaxes hard is that they often are written according to the official style guidelines.

arxiv-2501-17899.title: Position: The Right to AI
arxiv-2501-17899.creator: Rashid Mushkani, Hugo Berard, Allison Cohen, Shin Koseki
arxiv-2501-17899.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Rashid Mushkani, Hugo Berard, Allison Cohen, Shin Koseki. This position paper proposes a “Right to AI,” which asserts that individuals and communities should meaningfully participate in the development and governance of the AI systems that shape their lives. Motivated by the increasing deployment of AI in critical domains and inspired by Henri Lefebvre’s concept of the “Right to the City,” we reconceptualize AI as a societal infrastructure, rather than merely a product of expert design.

arxiv-2507-07900.title: Methods for Reducing Ancilla-Overhead in Block Encodings
arxiv-2507-07900.creator: Francisca Vasconcelos, András Gilyén
arxiv-2507-07900.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Francisca Vasconcelos, András Gilyén. Block encodings are a fundamental primitive in quantum algorithms but often require large ancilla overhead. In this work, we introduce novel techniques for reducing this overhead in two distinct ways. In Part I, we devise a method for any block encoding that approximately uncomputes all but one of the ancillae (freeing up the ancillae for reuse in later parts of a quantum algorithm), thereby effectively providing a “space-time tradeoff”.

pmc-12437730.description: IntroductionWhilst the DSM has streamlined research and standardized diagnoses, it faces criticism for falling short in addressing the intricate nature of psychiatric disorders. pmc-12446226.title: COPZ1: an example of non-oncogene addiction in human tumors
pmc-12446226.creator: Tiziana Di Marco, Debora Vergaro, Angela Greco
pmc-12446226.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Non-oncogene addiction (NOA) indicates that tumor cell growth/survival requires the activity of genes/pathways not oncogenic per sé, and dispensable for normal cells. NOA genes provide a wide repertoire of novel therapeutic exploitable tumor vulnerabilities. A large body of evidence demonstrates the dependency of several tumors such as breast, prostate, ovary, thyroid, glioblastoma and LUAD, on the activity of COPZ1, a component of the heptameric COPI complex. Thus, COPZ1 is emerging as a potential novel therapeutic target for tumors of different origin.

pmc-12574718.title: Education Research: Simulation-Based Interventions in Acute Stroke Care From Symptom Onset to Acute Treatment

pmc-12574718.description: Background and ObjectivesSimulation-based interventions serve several purposes in acute stroke care. This scoping review aims to map existing research to identify knowledge gaps and suggest future directions.MethodsThis review was conducted in accordance with the Joanna Briggs Institute guidelines for scoping reviews.

pmc-12704812.creator: Sofia Malosso Tronconi, João Felipe Federici de Almeida, Ana Terezinha Guillaumon, Sofia Malosso Tronconi, João Felipe Federici de Almeida, Ana Terezinha Guillaumon
pmc-12704812.description: Giant hepatic hemangiomas are benign vascular lesions that may cause abdominal pain, compression of adjacent structures, bleeding, and thrombotic complications. Management of symptomatic cases is challenging, especially for larger lesions. This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated the efficacy and safety of endovascular treatment through transarterial embolization, focusing on the embolization agents employed, reductions in tumor diameter, and associated complications.

pmc-13382608.description: Speech perception and production are linked in adults. pmc-13606456.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background/Objectives: Tryporyza intacta is a stem-boring pest that readily causes dead hearts in sugarcane seedlings and dead tops in mature plants, leading to large-scale yield reduction. Reverse chemical ecology studies of this pest contribute to its field biological control. During olfactory recognition, odor molecules are integrated by the olfactory nervous system after interacting with odorant-binding proteins (OBPs) and chemosensory proteins (CSPs), thereby regulating insect behavior.

uslaw-usc-t12-s5472.description: United States Code, Title 12 (Banks And Banking); Chapter 53 (Wall Street Reform And Consumer Protection); Subchapter IV (Payment, Clearing, And Settlement Supervision). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Not later than 1 year after July 21.
